title: ExtractBench Pro: The Long Tail of Document Extraction
html:
Two months ago, we released ExtractBench to measure and improve schema-based document extraction. What we learned from it has accelerated our research: in the LlamaExtract v2.5 release, even our lowest-cost tier scores above 93% value F1.

But the benchmark also had blind spots. Some real customers brought complex documents and schemas that the original 370 ExtractBench documents never covered. This is the long tail of document extraction. It’s why extraction remains unsolved, even as scores on ExtractBench climb toward saturation.

Today we’re releasing ExtractBench Pro, an extension built from those real long-tail documents. It covers six new challenges, each drawn from ways that real customers broke our assumptions. In the samples below, you’ll find values that appear only in intricate charts, rules on one page that change the meaning of another, dense domain jargon, chaotic layouts, and more. Rigid pipelines struggle on ExtractBench Pro, but agentic systems with the right tools can adapt.

ECG rhythm strips

Decision flowchart

Zoning atlas map

Single-line power diagram

Colour-coded shift roster

Probate family tree

Fund structure chart

Wireline well-log tracks

Nomogram with straightedge

Pipeline inspection strip log

Bars-and-line combo chart

Warehouse slot hatch map

Site plan with review marks

Hand-drawn ownership network

Time-location chart

Dark-theme bar panel

Subdivision plat

Sieve grading curves

Fibre splice diagram

Reservoir hydrograph strips

Synthesizing challenging documents

All of the pages you see above were generated from scratch by fully deterministic pipelines. From a single seed and configuration file, the pipelines combine synthetic contents with the formats and styles of real challenging documents sourced from across the web and from our customers. Synthesizing the data anonymizes the sources, while also ensuring high-quality ground-truth annotations that cover both value extraction and grounding.

This is similar to what we did for 45 of the 370 original ExtractBench documents. However, we have made huge leaps in the fidelity and diversity of our data transformations, in order to represent the breadth of challenges seen in long-tail data. The synthetic documents weave data dependencies across multiple pages, plot complex charts, and add perception challenges like photographs and multi-page tiling.

{
  "doses": [
    {
      "tracing_time": string"21:08",
      "bpm_band": string"50 to 74",
      "qt_class": string"A",
      "withhold": booleanfalse,
      "permitted_mg": number120
    },
    ⋮
  ],
  ⋮
}
{
  "agency_nurses": [
    {
      "nurse": string"Eriksen, Hollis",
      "chargeable_shifts": number13,
      "chargeable_hours": number147.5,
      "amount_due": number6850.83
    },
    ⋮
  ],
  ⋮
}
{
  "market_weeks": [
    {
      "week": number19,
      "new_listings": number2,
      "price_changes": number4,
      "lets_and_sales": number1,
      "withdrawals": number1,
      "listings_on_market": number32
    },
    ⋮
  ],
  ⋮
}

Using diverse configurations, all 100 documents in ExtractBench Pro are synthesized this way. The resulting dataset is split into six main challenges, featuring difficult layouts and formats which require frontier-level intelligence, multi-step reasoning, and efficient tool use to resolve.

Document conventions

In this task challenge, one part of a document contains information like legends or rules that affect how the rest of the document must be interpreted. The information could clarify how symbols, units, or amendments must be handled. Or, it can introduce filtering criteria so that only certain rows of a table are correct to extract. Document length increases the difficulty of this challenge, since finding the relevant information (especially when the extractor doesn’t know if it exists at all) is a needle-in-a-haystack problem.

House vocabulary

Commercial systems are trained on enormous aggregations of public data, and (hopefully) not your organization’s internal documents. When encountering your internal jargon, it is important to seek out your specific definitions (what counts as “bulk”?) and not jump to conclusions. On ExtractBench Pro documents, understanding internal terminology can completely flip what the extractions should be.

House counting rules

Classically, extract is expected to focus on values that literally appear in the document, but customers sometimes expect us to return values derived by aggregating multiple pieces of information. Fulfilling that requires an agent to read definitions from the schema and document, and use them to compute counts and sums.

Drawn relations

Many real-world documents rely on diagrams. They can convey organizational structures, procedures, electrical circuits, and other relational data in a visual manner that works for humans. However, this makes the same documents difficult for classical LLMs specialized in OCR and text. ExtractBench Pro contains relational diagrams where all or part of an extracted value depends on a line rather than a literal value. These relations can form part of a multi-step reasoning chain — the longer the chain, the easier it is for even the smartest agents to overlook a chart.

Charts inside documents

Similar to relational charts, graphs can visually convey a dense time series in a human-friendly way. Not only is this harder for LLMs to read, but these documents also rely on precise vision to resolve fine lines and intersection points. To make this work in ExtractBench’s data format, our schema breaks up continuous scales into a set of ranges, aligned with the axis tick marks, and asks the extractor to predict which range the value lies in at a given point. Some extractors get confused by their bias towards written text placed elsewhere.

Long chart sheets

Vision models depend on their inputs to be within a certain range of acceptable aspect ratios. Vertical data series like well logs and time-location charts can break that expectation by cramming all of that data into a single extremely long and narrow page. Our schemas for these documents can ask for values at hundreds of points, requiring an extractor to strategically locate and extract each value as efficiently as possible.

Results

We tested twelve systems on ExtractBench Pro: four extraction APIs, five coding agents, and the latest releases of our three tiers of LlamaExtract (Cost-Effective, Agentic, and Agentic Plus). Consistent with the original ExtractBench, there is a 30-minute time limit per document. A document that fails or exceeds that limit gets Value and Grounded F1 scores of 0.

During our analysis, we find that many documents experience a bimodal distribution of Value F1. One cluster of extractors is near 100%, while another cluster of extractors has much lower scores on the same document. This gives an important hint about how researchers should think about hill-climbing on ExtractBench Pro: a document is hard until it isn’t. How much lower the failed extractors score, depends on the proportion of fields in the document which relate to the challenge that failed. Therefore, to fairly measure the proportion of challenges passed, we add a new metric to ExtractBench: the proportion of documents with perfect (100%) Value F1.

  • LlamaExtract
  • Coding agents
  • Extraction APIs
  • 30-minute limit
  • Without the limit

Here’s what the results tell us:

  • The long tail is really hard. Compared to ExtractBench, LlamaExtract extractors drop by 18.5 to 47.0 percentage points of Value F1, and 22.9 to 30.4 percentage points of Grounded F1. Some extractors get zero documents perfect on ExtractBench Pro.
  • LlamaExtract is the frontier at low costs. Below 25 cents per page, our tiers form the overall cost-performance frontier for perfect documents, Value F1, and Grounded F1. Only at much higher costs are we overtaken by the most expensive coding agents. Nevertheless, we have huge room to improve on drawn relations and long chart sheets.
  • Coding agents are strong but expensive. They achieve the highest Value F1 and Grounded F1 on ExtractBench Pro, and our frontier plot shows why — coding agents burn tokens at per-page rates (Opus at 41 cents, Astra at 95 cents) that would break the budgets of most real document extraction customers, and Claude specifically often takes longer than the 30-minute time limit to do so.
  • Being good at value extraction doesn’t make you automatically good at grounding. LlamaExtract is generally good at both. Meanwhile, some coding agents and extraction APIs drop off dramatically when comparing their Value F1 to the stricter Grounded F1 metric, which requires them to correctly cite where in the document they got their extraction.

But most of all, we see the big picture: the more resources, versatile tools, and general intelligence you give a system, the better it adapts to the long tail of document extraction. We look forward to adopting that lesson, to make our next generation of LlamaExtract even better.

Get ExtractBench Pro

ExtractBench Pro is released today on the same channels as ExtractBench: the dataset, code and paper. Run your extractor on it and tell us about your progress on long-tail document extraction!

Download ExtractBench Pro

Get all 100 documents, extraction schemas, and ground truth.

Terminal

git clone https://github.com/run-llama/ExtractBench
cd ExtractBench
uv sync
uv run extract-bench download --dataset pro
uv run extract-bench status --dataset pro

html_zh:
两个月前，我们发布了ExtractBench来衡量和改进基于模式的文档提取。我们从中学到的东西加速了我们的研究：在LlamaExtract v2.5 版本中，即使我们的最低成本层分数高于 93%，也价值 F1。

但基准测试也存在盲点。一些真正的客户带来了原始 370 ExtractBench 文档从未涵盖的复杂文档和模式。这就是文档提取的长尾。这就是为什么即使 ExtractBench 上的分数接近饱和，提取问题仍然没有得到解决。

今天，我们发布了 ExtractBench Pro，这是一个根据真实长尾文档构建的扩展。它涵盖了六个新挑战，每个挑战都来自真实客户打破我们假设的方式。在下面的示例中，您会发现仅出现在复杂图表中的值、一页上改变另一页含义的规则、密集的领域术语、混乱的布局等等。刚性管道在 ExtractBench Pro 上表现不佳，但具有正确工具的代理系统可以适应。

心电图节律条

决策流程图

分区地图集

单线电源图

颜色编码的轮班表

遗嘱认证家谱

基金结构图

电缆测井轨迹

带直尺的列线图

管道检查条记录

条形图和折线图组合图

仓库槽口舱口图

带有审查标记的场地计划

手绘所有权网络

时间地点图

深色主题栏面板

细分平台

筛分分级曲线

光纤熔接图

水库水位线条

综合具有挑战性的文件

您在上面看到的所有页面都是由完全确定性管道从头开始生成的。通过单个种子和配置文件，管道将合成内容与来自网络和我们客户的真正具有挑战性的文档的格式和样式相结合。合成数据可以匿名化来源，同时还确保涵盖价值提取和基础的高质量地面实况注释。

这与我们对 370 个原始 ExtractBench 文档中的 45 个所做的操作类似。然而，我们在数据转换的保真度和多样性方面取得了巨大的飞跃，以体现长尾数据中所面临的挑战的广度。合成文档将数据依赖关系编织到多个页面上，绘制复杂的图表，并增加照片和多页平铺等感知挑战。

{
  "doses": [
    {
      "tracing_time": string"21:08",
      "bpm_band": string"50 to 74",
      "qt_class": string"A",
      "withhold": booleanfalse,
      "permitted_mg": number120
    },
    ⋮
  ],
  ⋮
}
{
  "agency_nurses": [
    {
      "nurse": string"Eriksen, Hollis",
      "chargeable_shifts": number13,
      "chargeable_hours": number147.5,
      "amount_due": number6850.83
    },
    ⋮
  ],
  ⋮
}
{
  "market_weeks": [
    {
      "week": number19,
      "new_listings": number2,
      "price_changes": number4,
      "lets_and_sales": number1,
      "withdrawals": number1,
      "listings_on_market": number32
    },
    ⋮
  ],
  ⋮
}

使用不同的配置，ExtractBench Pro 中的所有 100 个文档均以这种方式合成。由此产生的数据集分为六个主要挑战，具有困难的布局和格式，需要前沿水平的智能、多步骤推理和高效的工具使用来解决。

文档约定

在此任务挑战中，文档的一部分包含图例或规则等信息，这些信息会影响文档其余部分的解释方式。该信息可以阐明必须如何处理符号、单位或修改。或者，它可以引入过滤条件，以便仅正确提取表中的某些行。文档长度增加了这一挑战的难度，因为查找相关信息（特别是当提取器根本不知道它是否存在时）是大海捞针的问题。

家庭词汇

商业系统是根据大量公共数据进行训练的，并且（希望）不是您组织的内部文档。当遇到你的内部术语时，重要的是要找出你的具体定义（什么算作“批量”？），而不是急于下结论。在 ExtractBench Pro 文档中，了解内部术语可以完全翻转提取内容。

房屋计数规则

传统上，提取应重点关注文档中字面上出现的值，但客户有时希望我们返回通过聚合多条信息而得出的值。要实现这一点，需要代理从模式和文档中读取定义，并使用它们来计算计数和总和。

绘制关系

许多现实世界的文档都依赖于图表。它们可以以适合人类的视觉方式传达组织结构、程序、电路和其他关系数据。然而，这使得同样的文档对于专门从事 OCR 和文本的传统LLM来说变得困难。 ExtractBench Pro 包含关系图，其中提取的值的全部或部分取决于一行而不是文字值。这些关系可以构成多步骤推理链的一部分——链越长，即使是最聪明的代理也越容易忽略图表。

文档内的图表

与关系图类似，图表可以以人性化的方式直观地传达密集的时间序列。这不仅对LLM来说更难阅读，而且这些文档还依赖于精确的视觉来解析细线和交叉点。为了使这项工作在 ExtractBench 的数据格式中工作，我们的模式将连续刻度分解为一组范围，与轴刻度线对齐，并要求提取器预测给定点的值位于哪个范围。一些提取者因对放置在其他地方的书面文本的偏见而感到困惑。

长图表

视觉模型取决于其输入是否在一定的可接受的纵横比范围内。诸如测井曲线和时间位置图之类的垂直数据系列可以通过将所有数据塞入一个极长且狭窄的页面来打破这种期望。我们的这些文档的模式可以要求数百个点的值，需要提取器尽可能有效地战略性地定位和提取每个值。

结果

我们在 ExtractBench Pro 上测试了十二个系统：四个提取 API、五个编码代理以及三层 LlamaExtract（Cost-Effective、Agentic 和 Agentic Plus）的最新版本。与原始 ExtractBench 一致，每个文档有 30 分钟的时间限制。未通过或超过该限制的文档的“价值”和“接地 F1”分数均为 0。

在我们的分析过程中，我们发现许多文档的 F1 值呈双峰分布。一组提取器的得分接近 100%，而另一组提取器对同一文档的得分要低得多。这给了研究人员如何考虑在 ExtractBench Pro 上爬山的重要提示：文档很难，除非它不是。失败的提取器分数低多少取决于文档中与失败的挑战相关的字段的比例。因此，为了公平地衡量通过挑战的比例，我们在 ExtractBench 中添加了一个新指标：具有完美（100%）值 F1 的文档比例。

  • 骆驼提取物
  • 编码剂
  • 提取API
  • 30 分钟限制
  • 无限制

结果告诉我们以下信息：

  • 长尾巴真的很难。与ExtractBench相比，LlamaExtract提取器的Value F1下降了18.5至47.0个百分点，Grounded F1下降了22.9至30.4个百分点。一些提取器在 ExtractBench Pro 上完美实现零文档。
  • LlamaExtract 是低成本的前沿。每页低于 25 美分，我们的层级构成了完美文档、价值 F1 和接地 F1 的整体性价比前沿。只有在成本高得多的情况下，我们才会被最昂贵的编码剂所超越。尽管如此，我们在绘制关系和长图表方面还有巨大的改进空间。
  • 编码剂功能强大但价格昂贵。他们在 ExtractBench Pro 上实现了最高的 Value F1 和 Grounded F1，我们的前沿图显示了原因 - 编码代理以每页费率燃烧代币（Opus 为 41 美分，Astra 为 95 美分），这会超出大多数实际文档提取客户的预算，而 Claude 特别需要花费比 30 分钟时间限制更长的时间。
  • 擅长价值提取并不会让你自动擅长扎根。 LlamaExtract 总体上两者都擅长。与此同时，一些编码代理和提取 API 在将其 Value F1 与更严格的 Grounded F1 指标进行比较时急剧下降，这要求它们正确引用文档中提取的位置。

但最重要的是，我们看到了大局：为系统提供的资源、多功能工具和通用智能越多，它就越能适应文档提取的长尾。我们期待吸取这一教训，让我们的下一代 LlamaExtract 变得更好。

获取 ExtractBench Pro

ExtractBench Pro 今天在与 ExtractBench 相同的渠道上发布：数据集、代码和论文。在其上运行您的提取器并告诉我们您在长尾文档提取方面的进展！

下载 ExtractBench Pro

获取所有 100 个文档、提取模式和基本事实。

终端

git clone https://github.com/run-llama/ExtractBench
cd ExtractBench
uv sync
uv run extract-bench download --dataset pro
uv run extract-bench status --dataset pro
